title: 省试湘灵鼓瑟
author: 钱起
prompt: Make a precise instrument correction to this fine Chinese ink-and-watercolor illustration. Preserve the female Xiang River spirit, misty river mountains, restrained warm ivory paper and entire composition/large blank lower space. Replace the narrow plain guqin-like instrument in front of her with an ancient Chinese SE zither (瑟): a broader long rectangular wooden soundboard with many parallel strings and clearly visible rows of individual movable triangular bridges under the strings, resting horizontally on a low stone or wooden support. Her hands naturally pluck it. It should unmistakably have bridges, unlike a guqin. Keep delicate painterly detail, never add words, labels, symbols, seals or borders.
visualReview: 已把无柱的琴改成有独立弦柱的宽长瑟，女子在湘水烟山间弹奏，意境空灵，整页暖纸与大留白保留。
